packageRules.description: The service and the web app are applications: pin exact versions so the version declared is the version tested. The library (packages/logrono-bus) keeps floors, because Home Assistant resolves it together with its own pins.
The library's dependency ranges are a contract with downstream users (Home Assistant): widen them, never pin.
requires-python is support policy, not a dependency.
One PR for all non-major updates.
typescript-eslint supports TypeScript <6.1; hold TypeScript until it catches up.
uv builder and python runtime images must stay on the same Python minor: update them together.
Read the Python version out of the uv image's compound tag (python3.13-trixie-slim).
